neutral_codec: Neutral application Social reload package with finite relation r1 branch unchanged and g1 Gift branch; SocialRelation owns relation source checks, SocialGift owns Gift checks; typed ports prevent package cycle. Existing sr type alias compatibility may preserve callers; no second current index/bus/socket writer.

gift_branch.grammar: g1|recipient|actor|root_version|purpose|transfer_uuid; strict canonical UUID and exact field count. purpose GiftRecipientNotice or GiftSenderList only; each branch validates source sender/recipient role and current SocialRoot.StateVersion>=committed revision.
gift_branch.source: Exact committed Transfer UUID+finite GiftDescriptor, not send operationUUID/day integer/general hash; source reload must verify recipient Notice evidence for recipient purpose, sender/recipient linkage for sender purpose; stale/missing/forged generation/source/root fails closed. Later claimed source may still emit refresh-only acceleration, never award/create/reset.
gift_branch.wire: player_id=0 + ONE selector=1 per MIDForceReload frame, recipientfriend_notice or senderfriend_list; no184 hint.

delivery: Reuse PostgreSQL reference wakeup/listener, world-role indexed newest connection handles, admitted identity/liveness validation, single connWriter, finite2s deadline and existingmaxhandles. No network under gameplayTx/registry mutex; delivery failure cannot roll back committedGift.
